Answer (ollama / qwen2.5:14b):
POPE (Polling-based Object Probing Evaluation) is a benchmark for
evaluating object existence hallucinations in vision-language models [2].
It reveals that even state-of-the-art VLMs exhibit substantial false
positive rates [2]. The POPE benchmark measures accuracy, precision,
recall, and F1-score across Random, Popular, and Adversarial splits
(3,000 questions each) [5]. The Adversarial split targets objects
frequently co-occurring but absent in the specific image [5].
